title: Add one Project note through a stable shared operation contract

requirements.invariant: A note-create intent is bound to one stable AccountID and ProjectID. Project names, copied Client text and creator display text never identify the parent Project, widen scope or authorize access.

One AddProjectNote intent preallocates one stable ProjectNoteID before connectivity, carries nonblank text and a requested source, and reuses one OperationID so offline retry cannot create a duplicate note.

requirements.section: Security and Sync Requirements for Later Target Mapping
requirements.invariant: Command validity is not authorization. A later trusted handler must derive and verify the authenticated actor, preflight the exact Account-owned Project without enumerating missing versus denied, and assign authoritative creation time and final source; the caller cannot submit creator display, server audit time, revision, edit audit or deletion evidence.

AddProjectNote expresses one story-specific business intent through typed Ledger values and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, generic CRUD, edit/remove behavior or backend SDK type.

The note-create payload is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared operation fingerprint and receipt lifecycle. Client actor/time/requested-source fields are intent and UX evidence only, never authoritative server audit evidence.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Project-note creation operation accepts the validated typed command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or a stable failure. It can later be composed into ProjectNoteOperations without duplicating command meaning in app, MCP or a provider adapter.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no note row/projection, parent authorization, server handler, schema, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ProjectNoteCreationDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, Project, preallocated ProjectNoteID, validated text, requested source and finite capture-time intent. It contains no Project/Client name, creator display, authoritative creation time, revision, edit audit or deletion state.

AddProjectNotePayload contains only ProjectID, ProjectNoteID, ProjectNoteText and requested ProjectNoteSource. AddProjectNoteCommand binds that payload to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact parent Project reference and fingerprint, permits no caller-authored preconditions and revalidates all duplicated evidence on decode.

ProjectNoteCreating is the narrow backend-neutral add operation returning the shared OperationReceipt; command receipt validation requires the exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative note-row, audit, authorization or projection claim.

ProjectNoteCreationFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, precondition, parent, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing the verified ProjectNoteText, ProjectNoteSource and shared operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no project_notes table, Project foreign key, audit/source/revision/tombstone column, uniqueness rule, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative AddProjectNote handler, authenticated actor derivation, Account membership/Project visibility preflight, final source/time assignment, idempotency storage, lock, rejection result or note creation exists. The command carries the exact parent/note intent that a later handler must verify.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Project binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, Project-visibility check, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local note/operation table, optimistic note projection, upload connector, bounded-history rule or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact parent Project reference and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Project, note, text, requested source, parent reference, preconditions, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or turning client audit intent into authority.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable storage, process/device restart, parent authorization, optimistic note-row evidence or server apply.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project-note creation owns text only and contains no attachment reference, local bytes, image URL, upload, retention or media deletion behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Notes tab, ProjectContext/service, MCP note tool/schema, transport handler, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired. A later shared handler must derive trusted channel/source evidence rather than accepting an alternate MCP writer.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase embedded/nested note, missing actor/timestamp variant or source row is decoded, normalized, deduplicated, quarantined or reconciled.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no telemetry signal, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot persist or display a note, authorize/preflight a Project, assign server creator/time/source evidence, edit/remove a note, choose mutation roles, define schema/RLS/Sync/provider/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: A valid synthetic draft produces one exact-scope AddProjectNote command with a stable preallocated note identity, nonblank text, requested source and Project parent reference, while its payload excludes caller-authored creator display, authoritative creation/edit/deletion time, revision and authorization claims.

Representative commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Project/note/text/requested-source/client-time/parent/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, credential, server audit/result or provider claim.

Blank text, malformed requested source, invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Project/note/text/source/parent/precondition/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through verified shared or Project-note-creation stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, the same OperationID with changed note intent is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming parent authorization, server audit, schema, Sync, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Verified decision-independent Phase 1 AddProjectNote command boundary at exact implementation commit 15566c8dd766762656cb180a65caf0b4600841d5 and immutable Actions run 33622056438. It preallocates stable note identity, binds exact parent/text/requested-source intent and reuses the shared operation lifecycle. Requested source and client actor/time remain non-authoritative; a later trusted handler owns authenticated actor derivation, non-enumerating Project preflight and final creator/time/source evidence. Edit/remove role and revision policy, physical persistence, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access and cutover remain excluded.
